claims.subject: TR202 conceptual power levels
claims.object: 100%, 75% and 18.8%: 4:1 throttle from the nominal 75% level and 5.3:1 overall
claims.statement: Three power levels were examined in the conceptual design: 100% (thrust needed with one engine of a 4-engine cluster out), 75% (nominal) and 18.8%, covering a 4:1 throttle from the nominal level and an overall 5.3:1 ratio; a constant 98% C* efficiency at mixture ratio 6.0 was assumed, and % power, % chamber pressure, % total flow and % thrust were nearly identical.
qualifiers: conceptual engine assumptions, not test results
claims.quote: These power levels cover a 4:1 throttle from the nominal 75% power level and an overall 5.3:1 throttle ratio
